sloka: श्रुत्वागस्त्येरितं वाक्यं रामो विस्मयमागतः ।कथमासीत्तु लङ्कायां सम्भवो रक्षसां पुरा ।। ७.४.१ ॥
transliteration: śrutvāgastyeritaṁ vākyaṁ rāmo vismayamāgataḥ ।kathamāsīttu laṅkāyāṁ sambhavo rakṣasāṁ purā ।। 7.4.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words spoken by Agastya, Rama was filled with astonishment, wondering how the Rakshasas could have originated in Lanka in ancient times.
